scripts.dev:backend: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=1024" npm run dev --prefix Backend
scripts.dev:frontend: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=1024" npm run dev --prefix Frontend
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names "backend,frontend,worker" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:jobs"
scripts.build:backend: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=1024" npm run build --prefix Backend
scripts.build:frontend: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=1024" npm run build --prefix Frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:tests
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run test:e2e
